{{Quote|That's... not possible! That was Madog steel!|Sek'nos Rath|<ref name="DotJ:FS3" />}}
'''Madog steel''' was a highly durable and nearly unbreakable<ref name="DotJ0" /> grade of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]<ref name="DotJ:FS3" /> crafted by the [[Je'daii Temple Master]] of [[Vur Tepe]] [[Tem Madog]] and used as the primary component in a [[Je'daii]]'s<ref name="DotJ0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> [[Force-imbued sword/Legends|Force-imbued sword]].<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> It was thought indestructible until the [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] used his [[Xesh's Forcesaber|Forcesaber]] to break the Madog steel blades of [[Sek'nos Rath]] and [[Hawk Ryo]] in his [[Duel at the Rift|duel]] between the three [[Je'daii Journeyer]]s that encountered him.<ref name="DotJ:FS3" />
